name: Web Design
description: Local design helpers for HTML workers: palettes, WCAG contrast, page scaffolds, CSS tokens. No network, no extra deps.

tools.name: color_palette
tools.description: Generate a cohesive hex palette from a seed color or preset (dark|light|brand|ocean|forest|sunset). Returns primary/accent/surface/text + CSS variables.

tools.name: contrast_check
tools.description: WCAG contrast ratio between two hex colors. Reports AA/AAA pass for normal and large text.

tools.name: html_scaffold
tools.description: Return a minimal semantic HTML5 scaffold (landing|dashboard|form|article) with CSS variables and empty content slots.

tools.name: css_tokens
tools.description: Design tokens as CSS custom properties: spacing scale, radii, type scale, font stacks, shadows.
